name: Eisleben (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided light blue over white, charged at the centre with the city arms of Lutherstadt Eisleben (a pair of white wings on blue).
history: According to the city charter the flag is a bicolour in the colours blue and white in the ratio 1:1; the approval of the flag was granted by the Landkreis on 27 February 2009.

features.role: Eisleben arms — white wings on blue
